landing_intro: Create an organizer account and a dedicated workspace for your mosque, community group or organization.
landing_note: For organizations bringing people together through participation and engagement.
landing_panel_intro: Set up your account, verify your email and save your organization’s details.
feature_account_copy: Sign up, verify your email and securely return to your account.
feature_workspace_copy: Choose a name, workspace address and timezone for your organization.
feature_return_copy: Sign in to view your organizations and their saved details.
landing_status: Available now: organizer accounts, workspaces, members and groups.
landing_cta_copy: Create your account, verify your email and make your workspace yours.
story_intro: Start with your organizer account and a dedicated workspace for your organization.
saved_benefit: Your workspace, saved for your next visit.
dedicated_space: A dedicated space for your organization.
sign_out_description: You’ll need to sign in again to access your organization. Your saved workspaces will stay safe. Unsaved changes will be lost.
organizations_intro: Choose a saved workspace or create a new one.
signup_intro: Create your organizer account, then set up your organization.
signin_intro: Sign in to your saved organization workspaces.
verify_intro: Verify your email before creating an organization.
recovery_intro: Recover your account with a code sent to your email.
adult_organizer: I’m an adult authorized to set up and manage this organization.
setup_scope: Organizers can set up a workspace and manage private member records, groups and staff access.
setup_intro: Choose your organization’s name, a unique workspace address and its timezone.
slug_help: A unique name: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
authorized_organizer: I am authorized to create and manage this organization.
no_payment: No payment is required to create your workspace.
workspace_saved: Your organization is saved and stays available when you sign in again.
error_description: Your request could not be completed.
replace_password_description: You will use the new password to sign in. Confirm to replace the current password.
discard_setup_description: Your unsaved organization details will be lost.
error_account_unavailable: Account services are unavailable. Please try again.
error_adult: Confirm that you are an adult organizer.
error_code: That code could not be verified.
error_authorized: Confirm that you are authorized to manage this organization.
notice_account_created: Account created. Use Send a new code to verify your email.
notice_check_inbox: Check your inbox for a verification code.
notice_verified: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
notice_verified_continue: Email verified. Sign in if needed to continue.
notice_recovery: If your email belongs to an account, a recovery code has been sent.
notice_password_updated: Password updated. Sign in to continue.
notice_code_sent: A new verification code has been sent.
error_slug: Workspace address must be 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
error_refresh: Refresh the setup page and try again.
error_taken: That workspace address is already taken. Try another.
error_rate_limit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
error_workspace_unavailable: Workspace storage is not configured yet.
error_service: Account service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error_expired_code: This code has expired. Request a new code.
error_existing_email: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
page_description: Create your organizer account and your organization’s own workspace with Himmah Hub.
offline_description: Connect to the internet to sign in or open your organization. Your account information is never stored for offline access.
install_description: Add Himmah to your home screen for easy access. An internet connection is needed to manage your account.
install_ios: On iPhone or iPad, open Himmah in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen and Add.
install_other: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen, if available.
error_password_short: Use a password with at least 12 characters.
error_password_long: Use a password with no more than 128 characters.
error_auth_network: We couldn’t reach the account service. Check your connection and try again.
error_verification_required: Verify your email before signing in. Choose the unverified account option to request a code.
directory_roster_help: Private roster records, separate from login accounts. Use a nickname and follow your organization’s consent process.
directory_groups_help: Organize members into groups. A member can belong to more than one group.
directory_staff_help: Manage verified organizer access. Invitations are bound to one email address.
directory_no_matches: Try a different search or filter.
directory_get_started: Add your first record using the button above.
directory_archive_description: Change the archive status of {name}? History and group assignments will be kept.
directory_remove_description: Remove {name} from {group}? The member’s roster record will stay.
directory_access_description: This changes access to your organization. Existing saved records will be kept.
directory_invite_help: Create a private invitation link for an adult staff member. It expires after seven days and requires a verified account with the matching email.
directory_consent: I am authorized to keep this record and have any required permission or consent.
directory_discard_description: Your unsaved form changes will be lost.
directory_choose_group: Choose an active group for this member.
directory_share_help: Send this link yourself to the intended person. It is shown only now; create a new invitation if you lose it. No email has been sent automatically.
directory_copy_manual: Select and copy the link manually.
directory_join_help: Accept only an invitation you were expecting. Your verified account email must match the invitation.
directory_volunteer_access: Your volunteer access is active. Directory administration is reserved for owners and administrators.
directory_end: You’ve reached the end of this list.
directory_page_error: The next records could not be loaded. Your current list is still available.
directory_invalid_input: Check the entered details and try again.
directory_invalid_name: Use a display name of 2–80 characters.
directory_invalid_cursor: This list changed. Refresh it and try again.
directory_not_found: This workspace or record is unavailable.
directory_forbidden: You do not have permission to manage this directory.
directory_consent_required: Confirm your authorization and the required permission or consent.
directory_conflict: This record changed or access was removed. The list has been refreshed; review it before trying again.
directory_duplicate_name: That group name is already in use. Choose another.
directory_invalid_invitation: This invitation is invalid, expired, revoked or belongs to a different email. Ask the organizer for help.
directory_rate_limit: Too many changes. Wait a minute and try again.
directory_service: The directory is unavailable. Please try again.
switch_organization_help: Choose the organization you want to work with.
directory_group_members_help: Members of this group. To add someone, open Members and choose Add to group.
